data.one_liner: Flutter widget to create animated numbers.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedNumber widget that smoothly transitions numbers from a start value to an end value over a specified duration. Supports both integer and floating-point values with customizable text styling, prefixes, and suffixes.
use_when: You need to animate a numerical value like a counter or dashboard metric.
You want custom text formatting including prefixes, suffixes, and specific decimal points during animation.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or advanced Rive/Lottie animations.
strengths: Includes styling options like text style, alignment, prefix, and suffix text.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedNumber(
    startValue: 0,
    endValue: 2000,
    duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
    isFloatingPoint: false,
    style: TextStyle(
    color: Colors.orange,
    fontSize: 24,
    ),
)
